glosses: A conclusive success following an effort, conflict, or confrontation of obstacles; victory; conquest.

examples.text: the triumph of knowledge
After being defeated in three previous finals, Roger finally tasted triumph at this year's competition.

glosses: A magnificent and imposing ceremonial performed in honor of a victor.
Any triumphal procession; a pompous exhibition; a stately show or pageant.

examples.text: We are ready, & our daughter heere, / In honour of whoſe Birth, theſe Triumphs are, / Sits heere like Beauties child,

glosses: A state of joy or exultation at success.

examples.text: Great triumph and rejoicing was in heaven.

a ceremony held to publicly celebrate and sanctify the military achievement of an army commander.

examples.text: Scorsese's latest film is a triumph.

glosses: A card trick in which the cards are shuffled with half face-up and half face-down, then laid out so that only the observer's chosen card is facing upward.
To celebrate victory with pomp; to rejoice over success; to exult in an advantage gained; to exhibit exultation.

glosses: To succeed, win, or attain ascendancy.
